summary: Spec/docs gap, active design thread (latest 2026-01-22). Checkable facts: the DXIL.rst note planned in 2024-07 never landed; DXC emits LLVM sdiv/udiv not the DXIL UDiv op; and INSTR.NOIDIVBYZERO/NOUDIVBYZERO are unreachable from DXC because a/0 is const-folded to undef first (even at -Od).
title: Unspecified behavior from new-to-DXIL sdiv instruction
